operation: Dispatch existing release.yml on main after its reviewed merge and all three required CI workflows succeed
conditions: request SHA is a full hexadecimal commit
validated_sha is main or its ancestor with only docs/screenshots changes
latest push run on main for build.yml is success
latest push run on main for dsp-measurements.yml is success
latest push run on main for screenshots.yml is success
an existing same-main dispatch is not duplicated
mutation_checks: dispatch the request branch instead of main
authorization: User explicitly requested release.yml dispatch on main after merging. No account switching, new secrets, or credential exports.
